contexts.text: Thus there is a changed state of the Church, which is an earthquake. AC 3355:4. AC 4779:7.
The earthquakes at the Last Judgment. LJ 61:6.
There was a great earthquake () = the state of the Church with them completely changed, and terror. Illustrated. AR 396. AR 515. AR 516. AR 530. AE 400.

There was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, such an earthquake, so great () = as it were shakings, convulsions, overturnings, and the drawing down from Heaven, of all things of the Church. ( = that the Church was no longer. AE 1017.)
An earthquake = an inversion of the Church, which is effected through falsities and falsifications of truth. TCR 179:2.
An earthquake () = the perversion of the Church.
An earthquake () = the perversion of the Church through the falsification of truth.
An earthquake = a change of the state of the Church; for the earth = the Church; and a movement a change of state. AE 400:2, Illustrated. AE 499. AE 650:41. AE 676. AE 734:24. AE 1100:17.
The reason earthquakes take place in the Spiritual World, is that all the earths there are from a spiritual origin, and are changed with a change of the Church with them. Described.
